message: fix(merchant): wait for authoritative inventory after a successful sale
purpose: Retain the pending quantity and tooltip-tree repair. Keep sale actions disabled between a successful command receipt and the corresponding inventory snapshot, so a fast second click cannot sell another quantity from stale displayed state. Add native pointer coverage with deliberately delayed display snapshots while executing the real realm transaction. Keep all existing comparison, quantity, gold, replay and input assertions.
